title: Great pan, but marred on the first use!
text:
Great pan, but marred on the first use!. Using ONLY food-grade silicone tongs(Messermeister) to sauté vegetables, and clean with Dawn and a basic soft sponge, it marred (not scratched) all around the cooking area. That seems odd! I doubt it will effect the use of the pan, but exceptionally disappointed with the OXO finish.
It was a gift Now a week past the date of return!

description: Cook like a pro with the OXO Good Grips nonstick Chef’s Pan. The pan features a three layer, German engineered nonstick coating that provides effortless performance while using less oil and delivers quick and easy cleanup. Our pan’s scratch resistant, hard anodized body heats faster and more evenly than traditional aluminum, and the silicone wrapped stainless steel handle helps keep cooking comfortable. Angled side walls help liquids evaporate quickly, and the rounded bottom helps with efficient stirring. The durable glass lid makes it easy to check on your progress, whether you’re simmering stew or braising meat. Hand wash. Oven safe up to 390°F/200°C. 10 year limited warranty.
